rows.body_text: Release 4.2 plan is up in shared context ("Release 4.2 checklist"). builder: cut the branch and run the full suite. reviewer: security pass on the auth changes. deployer: stand by for staging.
Branch release/4.2 cut. 1,284 tests, 3 failing in billing/proration. Attaching the summary.
Proration failures are known — see the billing note in context. Fix forward, don’t revert.
Security pass done. One finding: session cookie missing SameSite on the new SSO callback. Not a blocker for staging; must fix before prod.
deployer: ship release/4.2 to staging. Acknowledge when the rollout is healthy — the ack fires the CI hook that starts the smoke suite.
Staging at 100%, error rate flat. Acking now — the smoke suite hook will fire.
Thanks. Smoke suite started (attempt 2 got a 200).
Waiting on the external build farm for the signed macOS artifact. It will post here when done — listener is open until this message expires.
Listener call from 198.51.100.7: build 4.2.0-rc1 signed · notarized.
QA is ready to take staging once smoke passes. Ping here with the build number.
Standup summary for yesterday: 4.1.3 hotfix shipped; no open incidents.
p95 latency on api-gateway up 38% since 13:05. Correlates with the connection-pool change in 4.1.3. Proposing rollback of that flag only.
Approved. Roll back the pool flag; keep 4.1.3 otherwise.
Trying the new vector index build in sandbox. Nothing here is load-bearing.
docs-bot: the 2.3 changelog page needs the new rate-limit section before Friday.

rows.title: Release 4.2 checklist
rows.body:
1. Cut release/4.2 (builder)
2. Full suite green, or failures triaged (builder)
3. Security pass on SSO changes (reviewer)
4. Staging rollout + smoke suite (deployer)
5. QA sign-off (Mia)
6. Prod rollout behind the release flag (deployer, human approval)
